newsitem.title: USA: Invacare sees rest of 1997 a challenge.
newsitem.headline: Invacare sees rest of 1997 a challenge.

text.p: Invacare Corp said Tuesday that the balance of 1997 will "be a challenge".
Invacare said that sales growth continues to be hurt by substantially reduced sales to its largest customer, reimbursement pressure in Europe and the strong dollar.

It said that these trends, which it expects to continue for the balance of the year, coupled with the uncertainty created by the Medicare budget debate and intensified price competition, indicate that the balance of 1997 will be a challenge.
The company said it is undertaking an analysis to determine if its position of industry leadership would be strengthened in 1998 and beyond by accelerating certain strategic initiatives.
The company said it remains optimistic about the long-term growth prospects for the company given the continued favorable demographics of its industry.

Invacare, a manufacturer of home health products and mobility products for people with disabilities, reported second quarter earnings of $0.33 a share, compared to $0.32 a share the previous second quarter.
